rationales.rules-based-checks-v3: The evaluated company uses deterministic static-analysis/SAST, dependency and vulnerability scanners, malware scanners, license/compliance checks, and security-policy enforcement tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk, CodeQL, and GitGuardian to validate generated code against secure-coding rules, known-vulnerability databases, secret patterns, dependency policies, and licensing requirements.
